method: Join v20 crosswalk output records to source archive IDLs by the exact CodeGeneratorJS output naming rule.
Resolve repeated IDL basenames by selecting the production WebCore IDL; test-only IDLs are not members of the production WebCore CMake IDL lists.
Resolve DOMWindow constructor attributes through CodeGeneratorJS.pm and DOMWindow.idl.
Resolve three wrapper-factory outputs through WebCore CMakeLists.txt GENERATE_DOM_NAMES calls and WebCoreMacros.cmake, binding exact .in inputs and make_names.pl.
Classify six PCH build files as target-level CMake compiler artifacts, with exact generated hashes in the v20 crosswalk.
limitations: Source lineage does not decide license applicability or license choice.
Exact final production image hashes and static-archive closure are not bound.
Recipient build/relink steps and complete production corresponding-source offer remain open.
PCH provenance identifies the pinned target build context, not a separately hand-authored source file.
